[[Seung]] is a [[collector]], a type of [[Non-player character|NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for weapons.

==Locations==
*[[Realm of Torment]]
**{{NPC location|Gate of Torment}}

==Dialogue==
:''"These [[demon]]s give us [[Necromancer]]s a bad name. Care to help me inflict a little pain on the [[Graven Monolith|graven monoliths]] {{sic}}? I thought that might get your attention, adventurer. If you go out and fight them, you could push them back a bit. Prove to me you've got the strength for such a task, and I'll reward you handsomely. Bring me 5 [[Demonic Relic]]s, and I'll give you:"''

==Trivia==
*There is a mistake in her dialogue. Although she talks about [[Graven Monolith]]s, you actually have to kill [[Torment creature]]s to get Demonic Relics.
*Seung is one of very few living humans in the whole of the [[Realm of Torment]].
